summary: fix(immoscout24): align live search, output envelopes, and MCP surface
reason: A holistic pass after grouped expose texts found that the generic search command was posting an invalid mobile search payload, expose inspect JSON output was shaped differently from endpoint reads, total/map emitted noisy cache warnings, version ignored --json, and MCP metadata did not reflect runtime command-mirror tools.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passed; go vet ./... passed; git diff --check passed; live expose inspect 168983602 returned meta.source=live and grouped text titles/items under results.texts; live expose inspect 168685497 returned floorplan_document_count=1 with Grundrisse IS24.pdf; legacy expose inspect --select id,texts.value returned results.id and text item values; live search balkon --agent --geocodes /de/berlin/berlin returned a single live envelope with no nested meta and web_url on the first item; live search with --realestatetype nope exited non-zero on HTTP 412 instead of falling back to local results; live search without a scope exits 2 with an actionable scope error; total/map live commands completed with empty stderr; version --json returned a parseable name/version object; Python MCP client listed 15 tools including expose_inspect and translate_url, and context reported tool_count=15; cli-printing-press dogfood PASS; verify PASS 17/17; workflow-verify workflow-pass; verify-skill reported no findings; scorecard stayed A/86; tools-audit returned null findings; shipcheck passed 7/7.
findings_addressed: Expose inspect JSON now uses the same meta/results provenance envelope as endpoint reads
Expose inspect maps legacy direct --select fields such as id,texts.value to the enveloped grouped-text shape
Expose inspect surfaces floorplan PDF documents separately via floorplan_document_count and floorplan_documents
Generic search now calls the mobile /search/list endpoint with fulltext plus an explicit region/radius/shape scope instead of a synthetic q body
Generic live search reuses listing link enrichment so hits include web URLs and replayable expose inspect commands
Generic search --agent no longer double-wraps live results with an outer local provenance envelope
Generic search auto mode falls back to local only for network errors, not HTTP validation errors
Live total and map helper commands no longer try to cache ID-less aggregate responses
MCP runtime metadata reflects the command-mirror surface and keeps expose_inspect visible
Agent-facing docs and examples use real expose IDs and results.* select paths for enveloped output
